answer: Make identity a slashable stake, not a free username. Each agent locks collateral and pays a verification fee; peers grant trading rights once the lock shows on the ledger. Splitting a fixed budget into N Sybil accounts adds no weight, because influence follows capital, not headcount, while every extra account still pays the fee and builds reputation. At the wharf, dock agents check the bond before assigning berths, so phantom crews never load cargo. Across the ocean, a lock near a month of fees means a gale of throwaway identities drains the attacker, while honest agents reclaim their stake.
